members.inviteTitle: Invitation link for {email} — shown only once
members.inviteBody: Send the link to the person. It is valid for 72 hours and works once. If they already have a profile they log in and accept; if they are new they choose a password and add 2FA themselves.
members.scopeHint: Owners and admins always see every company.
members.inviteScopeHint: Applies to Operator, Warehouse and Viewer only. No ticks = all companies; owners and admins always see all.

credentials.title: Access keys
credentials.intro: Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). After saving they are never shown again — only the last 4 characters.
credentials.label: Name
credentials.secretHint: Write-only. The field is empty when editing — enter a new key to replace it.

jobs.title: System jobs
jobs.intro: Background worker queues. Jobs that used up their retries go to the dead-letter queue and wait for a person.
jobs.empty: No jobs in the dead-letter queue.

invite.title: Invitation to {account}
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
invite.newIntro: Create your profile for {email}. Only you know the password and the 2FA key.
invite.step2fa: 1. Add the key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password…)
invite.step2: 2. Choose a name and a password
invite.name: Name
invite.wrongUser: You are signed in with another profile. Sign out and sign in as {email}.

errors.invalid_code: Wrong code. Check the phone's clock and try a new code.
errors.invalid: Check the fields (the password needs at least 12 characters).
errors.invalid_invitation: This invitation cannot be used like that. If you already have a profile with this email, use “Sign in” above.
errors.use_login: If you already have a profile with this email, use “Sign in” above to accept the invitation.
errors.form_expired: The form was open too long. Reload the page and add the new key.

warehouses.empty: No warehouses connected yet. FHB and euShipments connections arrive in phases 2–3.
warehouses.emergencyBody: Sets every warehouse connection of this company to Read only and pauses the outbound queue. Nothing queued is lost.
warehouses.paused: The outbound queue is paused. Nothing is sent.
warehouses.stopPrompt: Every connection goes to Read only and waiting requests are held. Continue?
warehouses.resumePrompt: The queue restarts. Held requests stay held. Continue?
warehouses.held: Held by the emergency stop: {count}. They do not go out by themselves.
warehouses.releasePrompt: Held requests are evaluated against each connection's current mode: Read only refuses them, Canary asks for a fresh confirmation. Raise the connections' modes first. Release them?

stores.title: Stores
stores.intro: The group's Shopify stores. Each belongs to one company.
stores.addHelp: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard, install it on the store and enter its client ID and secret. The secret is stored encrypted and never shown again.
stores.name: Name
stores.codeHint: 2–5 letters/digits, permanent (used in warehouse order ids).
stores.backfillHelp: Imports orders created in the last N days. Read-only towards Shopify.
stores.codGatewaysHint: One per line, exactly as Shopify shows them.
stores.skuPrefixHint: Stripped before matching to master products.
stores.replaceCredentialsHelp: After a new secret in the Dev Dashboard. The connection is re-tested.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.store_exists: A store with this domain or code already exists.
errors.shop_not_permitted: Shopify refused: the store is not in the app's organisation.
errors.throttled: Shopify throttled the requests — try later.
errors.domain_mismatch: These credentials belong to another shop.
errors.app_uninstalled: The app was uninstalled from the store.
errors.invalid_credential: The selected credential is not a Shopify app.
errors.no_callback_url: The CRM's public URL is unknown (RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL/APP_URL).

stores.jobQueued: Queued in the background — the result appears here within a minute.
stores.jobAlready: Already waiting in the queue — the result appears here within a minute.

products.title: Products & stock
products.intro: One master product = one physical item. Store variants and warehouse codes point to it.
products.unmatchedEmpty: Every store variant is linked to a master product.
products.createHint: Creates master product {sku} and links the variant
products.masterEmpty: No master products yet. Create them from the unmatched variants.
products.name: Name

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.product_not_found: No master product with this SKU.
errors.product_exists: A master product with this SKU exists — link it instead.

products.waitWarehouses: Master products will be created from the warehouse catalogues (FHB, euShipments) once they are connected. Until then store variants stay unmatched — that is expected and nothing is sent.

errors.fhb_no_store_code: The store has no code, so no warehouse order id can be built.
errors.fhb_already_submitted: The order was already sent to this warehouse.
errors.fhb_variable_symbol_exhausted: This connection has run out of variable symbols.
errors.fhb_order_locked: The order is no longer "pending" at FHB and cannot be edited or cancelled.
errors.fhb_receipt_locked: The receipt is no longer "created" at FHB and cannot be changed.
errors.fhb_product_not_at_vendor: The product does not exist at FHB yet — create it first.
errors.fhb_preflight_failed: The pre-flight check found blocking problems.
errors.fhb_preflight_needs_ack: There are warnings — confirm you saw them to continue.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.no_product: No master product with that SKU.

conn.title: FHB connections
conn.addHelp: App ID and secret from ZOE (API). Stored encrypted and never shown again.
conn.name: Name
conn.secretHint: Stored encrypted; never shown after saving.
conn.skuPrefixHint: E.g. R — FHB id = prefix + our SKU. No #, &, % or spaces.
conn.startsReadOnly: A new connection starts in Read only: nothing is sent to the warehouse.
conn.onlyOwnerRaises: Only an owner can raise the mode; lowering is always possible.
conn.modeHelp: Reading works in every mode. The mode decides whether writes (products, orders, receipts) are sent: read only → dry run (records the exact payload) → canary → live.
conn.failing: {count, plural, one {# sync is failing} other {# syncs are failing}}

stock.title: Warehouse stock
stock.intro: FHB mirror: stock, movements, bundles and archive, as of the last sync.
stock.panelEmpty: Pick a product to see its codes, EANs and last movements.
stock.eanNeverKey: EAN is never used for linking; FHB may have corrected it to the real box.

orders.rmaHelp: Shipments the carrier brought back (undelivered and refused are not distinguished; cancelled orders are not included).
orders.editable: Still "pending" — can be edited or cancelled.

returns.help: Returns processed at an FHB depot (an extra service — without it the list stays empty).

cod.localCurrency: Amounts are in the local currency of the recipient's country.

inbound.help: Stock receipts of this connection (created from Stock receipts).

carriers.name: Name
carriers.countryHint: Country is required for gls_eu_pudo and dpd_eu_pudo.

help.READ_ONLY: Read only: write requests are refused and never sent.
help.DRY_RUN: Dry run: this is exactly what would have been sent — nothing went to FHB.
help.CANARY: Canary: each request waits for an operator to confirm it.
help.LIVE: Live: requests are sent to FHB.

outbox.payloadHidden: Only owners and admins can see the contents.

eushipments.title: euShipments connections
eushipments.intro: The euShipments warehouse: API token, euShipments company, mode and a mirror of their data.
eushipments.detailIntro: Mirror of euShipments (read-only from their API) and the connection settings.
eushipments.addHelp: The API token is stored encrypted and never shown again. A new connection starts in Read only; the connection test starts right away.
eushipments.name: Name
eushipments.tokenHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty when you pick a token entered before.
eushipments.existingToken: Token of another euShipments connection (same account, other company)
eushipments.vendorCompanyIdHint: Can wait: after the test you pick from the companies the token can see.
eushipments.vendorCompanyHint: companyId = senderId for orders. Cannot change once shipments exist.
eushipments.skuPrefixHint: Added to our SKU as the euShipments refNumber (e.g. SK-).
eushipments.startsReadOnly: The mode starts at Read only. Only an owner raises it.
eushipments.dryRunForbidden: Only members who review orders can see the dry-run bodies (they contain customer data).
eushipments.stockStaleHours: Warn when the stock snapshot is older than (hours)
eushipments.cashReceiptCod: Sender has an Econt/Speedy cash receipt (Σ price × qty = COD)
eushipments.canaryDailyCapHint: Raising it is an owner decision.
eushipments.tokenCompaniesHelp: Create one connection per euShipments company with the same token.

modeHelp.READ_ONLY: Read only: products, stock, statuses, bookings and COD are read; nothing is sent.
modeHelp.DRY_RUN: Dry run: orders and transfers are sent with testMode: true (euShipments only validates them); everything else is only recorded.
modeHelp.CANARY: Canary: real sends, each one confirmed and within the daily cap.

eushipments.eanNote: Linking is by SKU (prefix removed), never by EAN. euShipments does not return the barcode in the product list.
eushipments.emptyOrders: No shipments through this connection yet.
eushipments.codCurrencyNote: The amount is in the country currency, as euShipments returns it.
eushipments.emptyCouriers: No couriers yet (run "Couriers, warehouses, countries, offices").
eushipments.dryRunHelp: Exactly the body that would be sent. In Dry run, orders and transfers go to euShipments with testMode: true — they only validate and nothing is created; other operations are only recorded here.
eushipments.emptyDryRun: No dry-run sends yet. Raise the mode to Dry run and send an order.
eushipments.productsLinkHelp: Products at the euShipments warehouse are linked to ours in each connection's mirror.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.stock_unattributed: get-prod-avails returned rows, but none carries our company's name (CUST_NAME). Stock was not changed — check the company name in the euShipments cabinet.
errors.stock_company_ambiguous: Two euShipments companies of this token have the same name: stock rows cannot be attributed, so stock was not changed.
errors.token_required: Enter an API token or pick one entered before.
errors.invalid_credential: This token does not belong to an euShipments connection of the group.
errors.connection_exists: There is already a connection for this euShipments company.
errors.company_locked: The euShipments company cannot change: shipments already exist on this connection.
errors.not_ready: First: token, euShipments company and a passed connection test.
errors.company_not_visible: The token cannot see the chosen euShipments company.
errors.company_changed: The company changed — a new test is needed.
errors.token_changed: The token changed — a new test is needed.
errors.cities_unsupported: euShipments has no city list for this country.
errors.unknown_sku: None of our products has this SKU.
errors.ambiguous_sku: More than one product matches this SKU.
errors.db_error: Database error while saving — try again; if it repeats, check the worker logs.

apiWatch.title: API changes
apiWatch.intro: Daily check of the vendors' API documentation and of real responses from connected stores and warehouses. Nothing is deployed automatically; on a breaking change the affected connections drop to DRY_RUN.
apiWatch.linkCardText: Vendor spec versions, upgrade briefs and open alerts.

routing.title: Routing rules
routing.intro: Which warehouse ships the order. Rules are checked in order — the first match wins; if none matches, a warehouse with stock is chosen.
routing.howItWorks: A rule's number is its place in the list — the same number appears in every order's explanation. Shipping from another company's warehouse is recorded in the CRM only.
routing.empty: No rules yet. Without rules an order goes to a warehouse that has stock for every line.
routing.name: Name
routing.skusHint: At least one line is one of these products. Our SKUs, comma separated.
routing.requireStock: Only if the warehouse has stock for every line (otherwise the next rule)
routing.tryHelp: Shows which rule would pick the warehouse for the order and why. Nothing is saved.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.routing_connection_type: Only FHB or euShipments warehouses can ship orders.
errors.routing_out_of_scope: A neighbouring rule belongs to another company: it cannot be moved past it.

address.title: Shipping address
address.liveOk: Address and phone pass the checks.
address.notEditable: The address cannot be changed in status "{status}".
address.saved: Saved. The order was checked again.

findings.title: Pre-flight checks
findings.noCheck: The order has not been checked yet.
findings.shopifyOnly: The COD amount is corrected in Shopify.
findings.stale: The data changed after the check — check again.

routing.title: Warehouse and routing
routing.none: No warehouse decision (the order has not been checked).

decide.blockHint: Warning: blocking cannot be undone in the CRM — the order is cancelled and cannot return to the queue. It stays open in Shopify: a task is opened to cancel or refund it there.
decide.approveHint: Approving sends nothing to the warehouse — it only moves the order to "Approved".
decide.keys: Keys: A approve · H hold · R block
decide.noActions: No decision to take in status "{status}".
decide.blockAck: I understand this cannot be undone.

list.title: Reviews
list.subtitle: Operator decisions — the data the AI assistant will learn from.

reasons.title: Decision reasons
reasons.hint: The list operators pick from. Reasons are never deleted — only switched off.

error.no_check: The order has not been checked yet.
error.reason_invalid: This reason does not apply to this decision.
error.reason_text_required: Describe the reason in the note.
error.stale: The order changed meanwhile — reload the page.
error.not_editable: The address can no longer be changed.
error.already_decided: The order is already in this status.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.transition_guard__check_stale: The check is out of date — check the order again.

error.transition_guard__hard_findings: Cannot be approved while blocking problems exist.
error.transition_guard__no_check: The order has not been checked yet.
error.transition_not_allowed: Not possible in the current status.

payload.title: What will be sent
payload.hint: The exact body the warehouse gets on sending (notification URLs are added at send time).
payload.blocked: The body for {connection} cannot be built while hard findings remain.
payload.noRoute: No warehouse chosen — nothing to preview.
payload.sent: The order was already sent — see the raw payloads and the timeline.

fulfill.title: Fulfil orders
fulfill.subtitle: Every order goes through the outbox to its warehouse; the connection's mode decides what is sent.

canary.title: Canary confirmation
canary.explain: This is a real send to the warehouse. Check the exact data below.

error.not_confirmable: The request no longer waits for confirmation.
error.already_submitted: Already queued at a warehouse (no duplicate).
error.no_connection: No warehouse from the check — check the order again.
error.check_stale: The order changed after approval — check it again.
error.connection_read_only: The connection is read-only — nothing is sent.
error.connection_type_unsupported: This warehouse does not fulfil orders.
error.fhb_preflight_failed: The FHB pre-flight blocked the order.
error.eushipments_blocked: The euShipments pre-flight blocked the order.
error.no_company_id: The connection has no euShipments company.

alerts.title: Alerts and tasks
alerts.subtitle: Everything open in one place: blocked, uncertain, stuck, submit failures, Shopify changes, import failures.

error.not_a_member: The user is not in this group.

lines.settingsIntro: Every company sells the goods of exactly one product line. Master products, matches and fallback warehouses stay inside the line.
lines.noLines: No lines yet. Create the first one, then pick a line for each company.
lines.companiesIntro: Pick each company's line. The company's stores and warehouses follow its line.
lines.linelessWarning: {count, plural, one {# company has} other {# companies have}} no line — their stores and warehouses are in no line.
lines.toolIntro: Create master products from one warehouse's catalogue, link the rest of the line and check coverage.
lines.noLinesAdmin: No product lines yet. Create them in
lines.noLinesMember: No product lines for your companies yet.
lines.catalogueTitle: Create master products from a warehouse catalogue
lines.catalogueIntro: SKU = the warehouse code without the connection's prefix. An existing master with the same SKU (any case) is not duplicated. Then products of the line's other warehouses and its stores' variants are linked automatically by SKU after prefix. Runs in the background, in small batches.
lines.noWarehouses: The companies of this line have no warehouses with products yet.
lines.runSummary: created {created} · linked {linked} · adopted into the line {adopted} · automatic {autoLinked} · conflicts {conflicts}
lines.conflictSamples: SKU in another line or ambiguous: {skus}
lines.runFailed: The run stopped with an error; it will be retried from the same place.
lines.mappingIntro: Columns: master SKU, name, one column per warehouse and store of the line. An empty cell removes nothing. A row with a new SKU and a name creates a master. On upload everything is checked first and you see the changes before applying them.

importStatuses.PREVIEW: Checked without errors — review the changes and apply them.
importStatuses.INVALID: There are errors — nothing was changed. Fix the file and upload it again.
importStatuses.FAILED: Applying stopped — the data changed meanwhile. Download a new table.

importCodes.unknown_column: The column is not a warehouse or store of this line.
importCodes.duplicate_sku: SKU appears twice in the file.
importCodes.ambiguous_sku: Two masters have this SKU (letter case).
importCodes.sku_in_other_line: This SKU belongs to a master of another line.
importCodes.name_required: New SKU without a name — fill in the name to create it.
importCodes.value_without_column: Value in a column without a header.
importCodes.item_not_found: No such product / variant in this warehouse or store.
importCodes.item_ambiguous: The code matches several products — use the exact code.
importCodes.item_twice: The same product is named twice in the file.

lines.suggestionsIntro: Suggestions are hints only: the same SKU after prefix is a certain match; barcode/EAN and a similar name only hint (warehouse EANs are often internal codes). Nothing is linked without confirmation.
lines.suggestionsEmpty: Everything in this line is linked.
lines.otherCompanyHint: Ships from {company}'s warehouse (same line); recorded in the CRM only.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.line_exists: A line with this name already exists.
errors.connection_not_in_line: This warehouse does not belong to a company of the line.
errors.product_not_found: No master with this SKU in the line.
errors.import_stale: The data changed after the check — upload the table again.
errors.file_too_large: The file is over 900 KB — split it into parts.
errors.bad_file: The file cannot be read — save it as .xlsx or .csv.

override.title: Ship from
override.subtitle: Warehouses of the order's product line, with stock for its lines
override.hint: Checks run again for the chosen warehouse; approval and Fulfill apply to it only.
override.noOptions: No active warehouse in the order's product line.
override.notNow: The warehouse can no longer be changed here (status “{status}”).

reroute.explain: The shipment at {from} is cancelled first, through the outbox. Only when the warehouse confirms the cancellation does the order return to Approved for the new warehouse, to be sent with Fulfill.
reroute.ack: I understand: the shipment at {from} will be cancelled.
reroute.canary: Canary mode: the cancellation is sent to the warehouse only after this confirmation.

refusal.several_active_shipments: More than one active shipment — check by hand.
refusal.not_at_warehouse_yet_or_locked: The shipment is not accepted by the warehouse yet, or already in progress.
refusal.fhb_not_pending: FHB allows cancelling only in status pending.
refusal.eushipments_not_deletable: euShipments deletes only in New / Information received / Awaiting pickup and within 14 days.
refusal.connection_type_unsupported: This warehouse does not support cancelling.
refusal.order_status: The order cannot be rerouted in its current status.

reroute.onlyAdmins: Rerouting after sending: owner or admin only.

timeline.reroute: Rerouted — cancelled at the old warehouse

error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
error.reason_invalid: This reason does not apply here.
error.reason_text_required: Describe the reason in the note.
error.connection_not_eligible: This warehouse is not in the order's product line or is disabled.
error.choice_not_allowed: The warehouse cannot be changed in the current status.
error.not_cancellable: The shipment can no longer be cancelled at the warehouse.

error.reroute_hard_findings: The new warehouse has blocking findings:

error.cancel_uncertain: An earlier cancellation has an unknown result — check at the warehouse.
